liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Lazy Lightning** (2 reviews): Recommended listening, alongside Sugaree, from the first set; Lazy Lightning into Supplication is picked out as a highlight [8][11]
- **Playing in the Band** (1 review, 1 other source): A very quick tape flip leaves a short gap, filled from the shnid 6685 audience source; Runs more than seventeen minutes, with the band gelling on a long journey [4][6]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): Singled out as a highlight of a brilliant first set [8]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): Reviewer wishes they had opened with it again, since it sets the second-set mood [9]
- **The Other One** (1 review): The Other One, along with drums and space, is singled out as great [11]
- **Stella Blue** (1 review): Reviewer urges listeners to pay attention to this one [15]

## The recordings

- **gd81-03-23.aud.macdonald.6685.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 21 songs; 179 min; rated 4.57/5 by 7 [1]. Said about its sound: Warm, ambient sound, though the reviewer finds the high end a bit excessive; Audience recording sounds somewhat remote and tinny; reviewer wishes for an audience/soundboard blend; Clearer than the Koucky recording but with less ambience and less Phil [6][8][15][16]
- **gd1981-03-23.fob.koucky.gmb.81275.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 180 min; rated 3.25/5 by 4 [3]. Said about its sound: Boombox-sourced recording has a round, close-up sound; other sources are crisper on top but flatter; Best played loud with the treble turned down; Jerry's leads come through clear and crisp [9][11]
- **gd1981-03-23.139843.senn421.streeter.miller.clugston.flac2496**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 173 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd1981-03-23.aud.weiskircher.32145.sbefail.shnf**: audience recording; 21 songs; 185 min [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended this as their first Dead concert and had never heard the band before [7]
- Early in the show, a song built as three or four players soloed in turn [7]
- The Rainbow Theatre acoustics did little to help Phil's sound [16]
- Spacey, jazz-accented Bird Song resembles the highly regarded one from 3-7-81 [6]
- Among the longest 1980s Bird Songs, behind the 3/7 UMD version [9]
- Reviewer ranks this above the Buffalo show as the best of 1981 [10]
- One of only 14 second-set Bird Songs; 11 came in 1971 or 1972 [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd81-03-23.aud.macdonald.6685.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording [1]
- **gd1981-03-23.fob.koucky.gmb.81275.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Bill Koucky; transferred by C Ladner; source: Condenser mics, portable JVC Boombox, 20 ft from stage left, hand held on a riser 6ft off floor > Maxell UDXL-Is [3]. Also: Master was a Maxell type I cassette recorded with a boombox, about 26 years old at upload; This fileset adds material from the earlier circulating MacDonald shn fileset [3]
- **gd1981-03-23.139843.senn421.streeter.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Frank Streeter; transferred by Charlie Miller and Scott Clugston; source: Source Info: Frank Streeter's Master Audience Cassette(at the soundboard); Sennheiser 421 > Sony TC-D5M (TDK MA90); Transfer Info: Cassette Master (Nakamichi… [4]
- **gd1981-03-23.aud.weiskircher.32145.sbefail.shnf**: source: AUD > MC > C [2]
